# Four ways a body fails

## The queue is the second question

The first question: does the room exist?

::: {.fragment}
**Delayed.** GSTAT: 8 years from statute to seated members. No statutory deadline required it to start.
:::

::: {.fragment}
**Yet to be built.** 9 bodies legislated, never constituted. ACI, the Mediation Council, 7 state Lokayuktas.
:::

::: {.fragment}
**Vacant.** APTEL's vacancy was filled only after a High Court writ. Allahabad High Court at about 50% strength. AFT benches fully vacant.
:::

::: {.fragment}
**Route ambiguous.** DRAT rerouting: Hyderabad appeals go to Kolkata. Two High Courts now hear writs about the same orders.
:::

::: {.notes}
This is the frame for the next five slides. Those five must be done in 8 minutes, not a minute more.

All four modes show up in the statistics as the same undifferentiated thing: pendency.
:::
